subject: Outlier completion lag: ClarityPay payment timeouts and mitigation coordination
messages:
From: Tara Singh <tara.singh@claritypay.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: ops@claritypay.com
Date: Thu, 28 Jun 2028 15:10:00 -0000
Subject: High tail latency -> payment page timeouts (26k failed attempts today)

Hi Marcus / Laura,

We're seeing a sharp increase in checkout failures starting ~09:40 PDT this morning. Users hit the payment confirmation step and the browser hangs for 15-25s before timing out. Our logs show ~26k failed completion attempts and a jump in 502/504 errors. This coincides with a spike in token completion p99 for the model route you host for us.

This is impacting live orders — conversion dropped ~7% during the window. Our team has rolled back a local change (no effect) and we need Redwood's help to understand root cause and a mitigation path. Can you confirm whether this looks like a queueing/backpressure issue or a model-side regression?

We can be on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Tara
Tara Singh
Head of Engineering, ClarityPay

Attachments: (log_snippets.txt)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara.singh@claritypay.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 28 Jun 2028 15:34:00 -0000
Subject: Re: High tail latency -> payment page timeouts (26k failed attempts today)

Tara — thanks for the flag and the log snippets. We're triaging now and will treat this as an escalation. Initial asks: can you confirm the route name and any request variants (long vs short prompts)? Also, is this impacting all regions or just US customers?

Immediate plan: 1) I'll pull p99 traces and queue metrics for your tenant. 2) Rishi (SRE) will check backlog/redis/kv cache pressure and concurrency caps. 3) If this is backpressure we may apply a temporary per-tenant concurrency override and route traffic to a warm dedicated pool while we root cause.

I'll follow up within 30 minutes with findings and a short mitigation.

— Marcus
VP, Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 28 Jun 2028 15:58:00 -0000
Subject: Re: High tail latency -> payment page timeouts (26k failed attempts today)

Quick update from infra triage:
- Observed a sustained p99 token completion increase from ~850ms -> ~6.2s starting 09:35 PDT for the ClarityPay model route.
- Queue depth (per-tenant queue) shows repeated spikes with >3x normal pending requests; concurrent inflight is at the configured cap (80) and many requests are queuing behind KV cache warmups.
- We see elevated KV cache misses for long-prefix prompts (their prompt set includes a long user history in a subset of requests) which increases backend work per request -> longer service time and queue buildup.
- No obvious model weight/regression (no recent model changes on that route), but kernel selection changed last week for low-latency path which may interact with long sequences.

Attaching p99 traces summary and SLO snapshot.

Immediate mitigation candidates (in order):
1) Emergency per-tenant concurrency override to 140 for ClarityPay (reduce queue wait).
2) Temporarily route ClarityPay traffic to a dedicated warm pool with slightly lower batching targets.
3) Enable request-level prefix caching for long history requests (TTL=10m) to reduce KV misses.
4) Apply circuity: shed non-critical background requests and enforce stricter client rate-limits.

I can apply #1 + #2 now if Marcus approves. Downside: temporary unit-cost increase.

— Rishi
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

Attachments: p99_traces_20280628.csv, slo_impact_snapshot_20280628.pdf
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: Tara Singh <tara.singh@claritypay.com>, ops@claritypay.com
Date: Thu, 28 Jun 2028 16:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: High tail latency -> payment page timeouts (26k failed attempts today)

Rishi — please execute 1 and 2 now: apply an emergency per-tenant concurrency override for ClarityPay to 140 and spin their traffic onto the warm dedicated pool (route id cp-prod-dedicated-3). Grace, can you validate capacity in cp-prod-dedicated-3? If that pool looks tight, mark a temporary burst policy to add one node.

Marissa — FYI I'm bringing this to the executive readout if the customer impact doesn't recover in 30–45m. Please prepare a 5-slide summary of impact/mitigation/cost delta.

Tara — we'll apply the overrides and confirm once traffic is served from the dedicated pool. Expect a follow-up in ~20 minutes with status and SLO impact.

— Marcus
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 28 Jun 2028 16:18:00 -0000
Subject: Re: High tail latency -> payment page timeouts (26k failed attempts today)

Confirmed: cp-prod-dedicated-3 has one spare node headroom. I will flip the burst policy to add one node if we cross 70% utilization after reroute. Rishi — when you make the override, push the metrics to the shared drive folder and notify the on-call for autoscaler.

I'll also start a short-run KV cache TTL change for the client route (10m) to reduce miss amplification; rolling immediately.

— Grace
Senior Infra Eng, Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara.singh@claritypay.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 30 Jun 2028 09:02:00 -0000
Subject: Post-mitigation update: ClarityPay routing override and next steps

Tara — quick update after the mitigation run: we applied the temporary per-tenant concurrency override (80 -> 140) and routed traffic to cp-prod-dedicated-3 at 16:10 PDT on 28 Jun. Observed results:
- p99 token completion dropped from ~6.2s -> ~1.1s within 8 minutes of reroute.
- 5xx error rate for checkout completions reduced by ~92% in the 30m window post-mitigation.
- KV cache TTL change reduced cache-miss amplification for long-history prompts; hit rate improved ~18%.

We're scheduling an executive readout Monday 09:00 PDT to review root cause and durable steps (kernel path check, model scheduling policy for long sequences, smarter batching heuristics). Action items:
- Rishi: deeper kernel + telemetry analysis (JIRA: INF-1248).
- Grace: validate dedicated pool sizing and propose autoscale policy change.
- Marissa: prepare cost delta and customer credit options for ClarityPay (HubSpot HS-58422).
- Marcus: lead exec readout and customer summary.

We left the temporary overrides active but will roll them back after sustained stability (TBD). We'll share the mitigation runbook and raw traces in the Drive folder. Sorry again for the disruption — we're treating this as high priority and will follow through with a durable fix.

Regards,
Marcus
VP, Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachments: mitigation_runbook_v2.md, temp_concurrency_override.patch
